_note: An ESP32-P4 rev >= 3 with an ESP32-C6 co-processor on SDIO, as on the Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6 boards: the P4 runs IDF v5.5.4's wifi_station with ESP-Hosted 2.12.13 (examples/esp-hosted-p4), the C6 the ESP-Hosted slave, both from their mask ROMs, in lock-step in this tab (esp32p4::coproc). The C6 joins the virtual access point and the P4 gets its address through it. The stub is the C6 slave's bb_init (bb_init=0 in the CLI's --coproc).
